newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs close mixed as miners continue to shine.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs close mixed as miners continue to shine.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange closed mixed Monday as mining shares continued to dominate investor attention, brokers said.
They predicted light gains Tuesday on the miners' healthy prospects -- boosted by the rising price of zinc -- and on expectations of good first half corporate results.

According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index .IGRA rose 0.40 percent to 2,256.87 points Monday while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL lost 0.02 percent to 3,262.43. Volume was a healthy 48.6 million soles ($18.5 million) on 2,500 trades.

"In the short-term, we believe zinc will break the barrier of $1,500, which is why the zinc companies are rising strongly every day. I am sure that their next financial balances will come out very well," said Manuel Torres, of Finvest brokerage.
Polymetallic miner Morococha was Monday's principal winner, with a 10.01 percent rise to 9.12 soles, while another polymetallic firm Perubar advanced 9.25 percent to 9.45 soles.
Among the losers was brewery group Union de Cerveceras Backus, off 2.33 percent to 2.52 soles. Overall, 37 stocks fell, 31 gained and 23 were flat.
